chore: update TypeScript to 6 (#2770)

* chore: update TypeScript to 6

TypeScript 6 defaults strict to true and types to []. import-map and
generator now typecheck under strict; ImportMap.mapUrl is narrowed to URL
since the constructor always assigns one. The CLI tsconfig had a dead
include path and a typeRoots that hoisting breaks, so its typecheck never
ran; it is now wired up with strict false, matching its previous settings.
